title: A farming-system claim needs the right evidence
subtitle: Compare a programme profile, proposed outputs and a published farmer account.
summary: Compare a programme profile, proposed outputs and a published farmer account. Keep place, time and uncertainty attached to each claim.

passages.title: Published account with a location problem
passages.text: The 19 May 2026 MSSRF feature presents a farmer’s reported seed choices through an institutional writer. Its opening names Nuaguda and its ending Kumbharaguda. The selected reading cannot resolve that mismatch.
passages.context: Original bounded summary of the dated source reading; see source scope and limits.

passages.title: An original inquiry matrix
passages.text: Seed access: which source, occasion and household? Diversity: which varieties, sampling frame and year? Labour: whose time and compared with what? Food preferences: whose account? Decision-making: who could choose and who could not? None of these questions is answered merely by adding a variety count.
passages.context: Original fictional scenario; associated source supplies a method/context only, not these facts.

claims.text: Distinguish proposed outputs from demonstrated outcomes.
claims.qualification: Dated FAO/MSSRF institutional accounts of Koraput; source-literacy exercise, not an agronomic evaluation or a representation of every community. The feature’s village discrepancy remains unresolved.

context: No farmer quotation, image, interview transcript or cultivation instruction is reproduced. This lesson examines the published accounts and their limitations.
The raw-capture stop and unresolved location issue are retained; this authoring does not count as a resolution or community participation.
reviewLimitations: Local author check only. No independent reviewer, professional credential, actual learner/access observation, community endorsement or physical outcome is claimed.

prompts.claim: The plan’s output table proves the proposed work was completed.
prompts.feedback: An implementation record would be needed; a plan cannot fill it.

prompts.claim: The feature supports a single unambiguous village pin.
prompts.feedback: Both conflicting names remain visible; no map pin or guessed correction is supplied.

prompts.claim: The profile gives a verified current census.
prompts.feedback: Historical reference periods cannot become a current count through a new reading date.

prompts.claim: These materials have institutional connections and should not be counted as three independent confirmations.
prompts.feedback: Follow authorship, hosting and programme relationships before assessing independence.

prompts.claim: More crop varieties alone proves less labour.
prompts.feedback: Labour needs its own measurement and distributional context, not a proxy count.

activity.transfer: Choose one matrix row and specify a question, an appropriately scoped source, a date/place requirement and what permission would be needed for a participant account. Retain unknowns instead of filling them with the programme narrative.
rubric: Distinguish proposed outputs from demonstrated outcomes.
Retain the location discrepancy and historical time scope.
Check source dependence before claiming corroboration.
Use a distinct evidence question for each system outcome.
